latest_release.body:
## English

**Portuguese, Android save backup and import, foldable fullscreen on Android, a 3D resolution setting, and a lighter touch overlay on iOS.** On iOS, make a new package with the new shell. On Android, install the new APK over the old one and **make a new import pack from the 2.3.0 source** (the 2.2.x pack is refused). Your saves are untouched.

| Asset | For |
|---|---|
| `D2RMobile-android.apk` | **New in 2.3.0.** Android 12 and later (ARM64, Vulkan 1.1). Contains no game content. Needs an import pack made from the 2.3.0 source |
| `D2RMobile-shell-build-input.zip` | **New in 2.3.0.** Shell for iOS 26 and later ([NO_XCODE.md](docs/NO_XCODE.md)). Build input, not installable |
| `D2RMobile-shell-ios18-build-input.zip` | **New in 2.3.0.** Shell for iOS 18 – 25 ([OLDER_SYSTEMS.md](docs/OLDER_SYSTEMS.md)). Build input, not installable |
| `D2RMobile-harmony-shell-unsigned.hap` | Same file as v2.0.0 |

### New

- **Brazilian Portuguese** as the sixth language: all of our own text, map name plates, touch wording, and the Portuguese voice-over when your game files have it. Options → Custom now has six language choices (#224, thanks @charleslana).
- **Android: back up and import saves** without root. Put an empty `export` file in `Download/S2X/D2R Mobile/` and start the App to copy your saves to `save-export/<date-time>/`; put saves in a `save-import` folder there to add them. Import only adds characters and never replaces one already on the phone; an imported shared stash is merged. See [ANDROID.md](docs/ANDROID.md) (#213, @yyan160).
- **"3D resolution" in Options → Custom**: power saver 60 %, balanced (the platform default), sharp 100 %. Takes effect when you tap Apply (#214, @yyan160).
- **Android: true fullscreen on screens narrower than 16:9** (foldable inner panels, 4:3 tablets): the 3D fills the screen and the UI sits at 16:9 along the bottom, as on iPad (#221, thanks @vickwv).

### Improvements and fixes

- **iOS: the touch overlay no longer redraws the whole screen on every finger move**, and the skill buttons check their slots less often: less CPU while you play (#226, thanks @dormonbear).
- **Android: no crash on GPUs that lack linear filtering for some formats** (seen on a MediaTek / Mali OPPO Pad); those textures fall back to nearest sampling (#218, thanks @rex-chang).
- **Android: the Custom page no longer shows the iCloud row**, which did nothing there (#212, @yyan160).

## 中文

**新增葡萄牙语、安卓存档备份与导入、安卓折叠屏全屏、3D 清晰度设置；iOS 触屏层更省。** iOS：用新壳重新出一次安装包。安卓：覆盖安装新 APK，并**用 2.3.0 源码重做导入包**（2.2.x 的导入包会被拒）。存档都不用动。

| 附件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `D2RMobile-android.apk` | **2.3.0 新包**。Android 12 及以上（ARM64、Vulkan 1.1）。不含游戏内容。要配 2.3.0 源码做的导入包 |
| `D2RMobile-shell-build-input.zip` | **2.3.0 新壳**。iOS 26 及以上（[NO_XCODE.zh-CN.md](docs/NO_XCODE.zh-CN.md)）。是构建输入，不能直接装 |
| `D2RMobile-shell-ios18-build-input.zip` | **2.3.0 新壳**。iOS 18 – 25（[OLDER_SYSTEMS.zh-CN.md](docs/OLDER_SYSTEMS.zh-CN.md)）。是构建输入，不能直接装 |
| `D2RMobile-harmony-shell-unsigned.hap` | 与 v2.0.0 相同 |

### 新增

- **巴西葡萄牙语**，第六种语言：我们自己加的文字、地图名牌、触屏提示都有葡语，游戏文件里有葡语配音时用葡语配音。选项 → 自定义里语言变成六项（#224，感谢 @charleslana）。
- **安卓：存档备份与导入**，不用 root。在 `Download/S2X/D2R Mobile/` 放一个名为 `export` 的空文件再打开 App，存档就拷到 `save-export/<日期-时间>/`；把存档放进那里的 `save-import` 文件夹再打开 App 就导入。导入只加角色、不换掉手机上已有的；导入的共享仓库会并进来。详见 [ANDROID.zh-CN.md](docs/ANDROID.zh-CN.md)（#213，@yyan160）。
- **选项 → 自定义新增「3D 清晰度」**：省电 60% / 均衡（各平台原缺省）/ 清晰 100%，点「应用」即生效（#214，@yyan160）。
- **安卓：比 16:9 窄的屏幕真全屏**（折叠屏内屏、4:3 平板）：3D 铺满整屏，界面按 16:9 贴底，与 iPad 相同（#221，感谢 @vickwv）。

### 改进与修复

- **iOS：触屏层不再在手指每次移动时重画整屏**，技能按钮也不再每次都查一遍格子：玩的时候 CPU 占用更低（#226，感谢 @dormonbear）。
- **安卓：部分显卡对某些格式不支持线性过滤时不再闪退**（联发科 / Mali 的 OPPO Pad 上出现过），这些贴图改用最近点采样（#218，感谢 @rex-chang）。
- **安卓：自定义页不再显示 iCloud 那一行**（安卓上它不起作用）（#212，@yyan160）。

detail.readme:
# D2R Mobile **An open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion, for iOS, macOS, Android and HarmonyOS.** It brings the Nintendo Switch release you bought, expansion included, to iPhone, iPad and Mac in full: the original game code runs natively, every control is rebuilt for touch, the frame rate holds at 60 fps, and you are in a game one second after the main menu. There is now a native macOS version as well (first version): on an Apple silicon Mac it starts on double-click and works with keyboard, mouse and gamepad. **Since v2.0 there is an Android version** (community port): the same game program executes natively on ARM64 Android phones, with the graphics reimplemented on Vulkan; on a Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 phone the camp and the Den of Evil and Cow Level fights all run at a median 60 fps (see "Android" below); a HarmonyOS version runs on the same engine (community port: an unsigned shell from the Releases page that you re-sign yourself, nothing to build; see "HarmonyOS"). Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15) has a community port (developer preview) that has reached the character-selection screen only on its author's device; see the device table below. This is not a tech demo that "sort of runs". It is a mobile version polished for daily play, from your first character all the way through the endgame. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS 26 and later; iOS 18 – 25 with the older-API build) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later; macOS 15 – 25 with the older-API build) · Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15; community port, developer preview) · Android phones (ARM64, Android 12 or later, Vulkan 1.1; community port) · HarmonyOS phones (HarmonyOS NEXT; community port, unsigned shell from the Releases page that you re-sign yourself) · Game version: Switch release with Reign of the Warlock, 1.0.34.0 (corresponds to PC version 3.3.94012) · English / 中文 / Español / Русский / 한국어 · License: MIT · **Bring your own game files** 中文: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) · Español: [README.es.md](README.es.md)

| 100% | 60 fps | about 1 s | about 3.8 W | |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | The original gameplay, because it is the original program | Steady, with no drops once the device warms up | From the main menu into a game | Whole-device power draw at 60 fps | ## What it is, and what it is not **It is:** - The game's own aarch64 program, **executing directly on the device**, with no emulated CPU. iPhone and Switch use the same class of processor; only the handful of instructions that cannot run unchanged under Apple's kernel are rewritten, and every other byte of the program is left exactly as shipped. Every class, every Runeword, Terror Zones, bosses, drop rules and quest flow are identical to the original. - The platform services the game expects — system calls, the file system, the graphics API, audio, input — provided by a small host written for Apple platforms. The graphics API is reimplemented entirely — on Metal on Apple devices, on Vulkan on Android — with no emulation layer in between, and the shaders are translated offline from the game's originals. - A port built for phones, and taken all the way: a complete touch control scheme, edge-to-edge iPhone and true full-screen iPad display, controller support, a power saver mode, save sync, six languages (English, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese), and a whole set of endgame modes and quality-of-life features the original never had. **It is not:** - An emulator, cloud gaming, or streaming. - **A source of game content. It contains none and distributes none.** There is no game program, art, text, data table or shader in this repository; all of that is generated on your own machine from your own files (see [docs/GAME_FILES.md](docs/GAME_FILES.md)). What the repository does carry is the interface information we recorded to make the port work — shader interface descriptions, the graphics API function table, addresses inside the program and the like — listed item by item in [docs/DERIVED.md](docs/DERIVED.md). - Online. There is no multiplayer; the game runs fully offline and needs no online account. ## Battle-tested All **44** iPhones and iPads in the closed beta — 35 devices registered for direct install (25 iPhones and 10 iPads), plus 9 TestFlight accounts with one device each — **completed Normal, Nightmare and Hell with multiple characters**, and the experience was excellent. From an iPhone 14 Pro Max with 6 GB of memory to the latest iPad Pro, not one device fell behind. | | Models | |---|---| | iPhone | 14 Pro Max, 15, 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, 17 Pro Max and more | | iPad | iPad Air, iPad mini, iPad Pro 11-inch and 12.9 / 13-inch (including M2 and M4) and more | | Lowest model tested | **iPhone 14 Pro Max (A16, 6 GB): a flawless 60 fps** | iPhone and iPad share a single install package.

## Fast, smooth, and easy on the battery Measured on a real device (iPhone 17 Pro Max): | Item | Reading | |---|---| | In-game frame rate | **60 fps**, steady, with no drops once the device warms up | | App launch | 0.15 s | | To the main menu | about 1 s | | From the main menu into a game | **about 1 s** | | Quick Restart, back in a game | about 1.2 s | | Longest frame when changing acts | about 0.1 s | | Whole-device power, 60 fps | **about 3.8 W** (in camp, 50% brightness): nearly 5 hours of continuous play on a full charge | | Whole-device power, power saver mode at 30 fps | **about 1.85 W**, about half the 60 fps figure, for about twice the battery life | Measurement conditions: power is whole-device power measured on 2026-10-10 on an iPhone 17 Pro Max, standing in the Act I camp at 50% brightness, with 60 fps and power saver mode measured in the same scene; battery life is calculated from the measured power and the battery capacity, not by playing from full to empty. Launch and game-entry times were measured on the same model in 2026-10; frame rate and act-change readings were taken on the same model on 2026-10-12 while moving through areas and changing acts after entering a game. The install package is only a little over 100 MB. The game resources (about 5.6 GB) are placed on the phone separately, and updating the app touches neither your saves nor the resources. Why it is this fast: the program executes natively, and not a single instruction goes through emulation; graphics go straight to Metal; every shader is translated offline and compiled ahead of time, so nothing is compiled when you enter a new scene. Older chips (A16 and earlier, such as the iPhone 14 family and iPhone 15) do not support the game's original compressed texture format; they need an extra texture pack made from your own game files, and then run at full frame rate too — see [docs/LEGACY_DEVICES.md](docs/LEGACY_DEVICES.md). ## Redesigned for fingers This is not a gamepad pasted onto the screen. Every panel and every action was rebuilt for fingers under one design principle: **keep the original interface language, and use gestures instead of adding buttons to the screen**. Text sizes and tap targets are sized for fingers. You know how to play the moment you pick it up, and it stays comfortable over long sessions.

- **Move**: a virtual stick with precise diagonals; tap an NPC or the ground to path there automatically; doors, portals and cave entrances are tappable across their whole surface. - **Fight**: press a skill button to cast, hold to keep casting, **drag to aim at any angle**; nearby monsters are targeted automatically. Two skill sets. Skills on your secondary weapons cast with one tap — the game swaps weapons, casts, and swaps back — and the button shows the charges remaining. - **Boss health bar**: pinned to the top of the screen, showing the percentage remaining. - **Items**: tap, double-tap, long-press and drag and drop all track your finger. Double-tap gear to equip or unequip it; drag an item anywhere onto the vendor panel to sell it; on a stack, double-tap takes 1 and long-press takes 3; long-press an empty inventory slot to sort everything. - **Text**: typed with the system keyboard. Character names can be in Chinese; leave the name blank for a random one. - **Screen**: on iPhone the 19.5:9 display is filled edge to edge, clear of the notch and rounded corners; on iPad the game fills the entire screen, and the interface centers itself when you open a panel; the 3D picture can be brightened. ### Controller Connect a controller and press any button: the interface switches to the original controller layout, with button prompts at the bottom of every panel. Touch the screen and you are back in the touch interface instantly. Inventory, stash, skill tree, Chronicle and settings are fully controller-navigable, with the same button mapping as on Switch. With an Xbox controller the layout switches automatically to the PC / Xbox one (bottom confirms, right goes back) and the prompts show Xbox button icons; there is nothing to turn on. With a PlayStation controller (DualSense or DualShock 4) the prompts switch to the game's own PlayStation button icons (✕ confirms, ○ goes back), contributed by [@Ti800](https://github.com/Ti800) ([#119](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/119)).

## New ways to play, on top of the original Finishing the original game is only the beginning. Without touching the original rules, we added a full set of endgame content that keeps you farming. ### Greater Rift Enter through the red portal in Harrogath after completing Hell. There are 100 levels, and the monsters grow stronger with each one; fill the progress bar and slay the Rift Guardian within 15 minutes to clear a level. Every 2 levels cleared grants +1 Skill Point and +5 Stat Points, and the skill level cap rises from 20 to 40. Every 10 levels has a first-clear reward, and clearing level 10 unlocks six new equipment slots for your mercenary.

### Endgame Boss Rush, Elysium mode, and the Kill Board - **Endgame Boss Rush**: unlocks after completing Hell, with 12 stages; stage 11 is Diablo Clone, and stage 12 is the three Uber bosses. - **Elysium mode** (chosen at character creation): Unique ×5, Set ×3, Runes ×5; the "no drop" chance is cut to a tenth, and bosses always drop as on a first kill. - **Kill Board**: for every boss, the number of kills, the time of the first kill, how many Unique and Set items it has dropped, and your best and average kill times.

### Storage: a collector's paradise - **Chronicle stash**: every identified Unique and Set item has its own fixed slot, shared by all characters, searchable, with deposit and withdraw; the Deposit button sends the Unique and Set items in your inventory and Horadric Cube there in one tap. - **Stash**: widened to 14 columns, with 5 personal pages and 5 shared pages. - **Trove**: the gem, rune and material pages merged into one, with the Horadric Cube's crafting grid in the middle, so finding things and crafting no longer means flipping between pages. Runes, gems and materials you put into the personal or shared pages are filed here automatically. - **Pouch**: an extended inventory. Runes and gems found in the field go into it automatically and take up no inventory space.

### Effortless farming | | | |---|---| | Auto-recast buffs | Buff skills you have learned do not need a slot on the skill bar: when a buff runs out, it is recast the moment you stand still; buffs that come from your secondary weapons (such as Battle Orders from Call to Arms) swap weapons, recast and swap back on their own | | Potions and belt | Auto-drink has two tiers: a healing potion below 50% Life, a rejuvenation potion below 30%; **your mercenary is fed automatically by the same rule**. Potions on the ground are picked up automatically when the belt has room; double-tap an empty belt slot to refill the whole belt | | Loot filter | From Nightmare on, the original loot filter is switched on automatically to hide clutter: light filtering in Nightmare, heavy in Hell | | Auto-pickup | Low runes and gems go straight into the Pouch; the high ones are left for you to pick up yourself | | Valuable drop alerts | High runes and Unique items raise a light beam and land with a different drop sound; the phone vibrates at one of three strengths — light, medium or heavy — according to value | | Runeword helper | Long-press a socketed base to list the Runewords it can make and their stats; once you have the runes, socket them all in one tap | | Minimap guidance | Every map marks its Waypoint and exits, labelled "Waypoint" and with the name of the area each entrance leads to (iOS / Mac); every quest goal is on the map; when a target is off screen, its name is written along the screen edge | | Chores removed | Free identification, free Town Portal with no scrolls needed, spawning right beside the Waypoint, Quick Restart, refreshable vendor stock, free and unlimited respecs at Akara | | Saves | Saved immediately when you switch apps, swipe the app away or quit; iCloud sync across devices (requires signing with a paid developer account) | | Entertainment mode (experimental) | Over-the-shoulder and first-person camera: drag the right half to look around, arrows for monsters off the picture, a facing pointer on the map ([details](docs/over-the-shoulder-camera.md); contributed with [@yyan160](https://github.com/yyan160), [#165](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/165)) | Most features can be toggled one by one in game under Options → Custom.

### English, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese The whole game switches between English, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese under Options → Custom (six options in two rows of three); after a restart, the interface is in the language you chose. On first launch it follows your device language (Spanish from Spain uses the game's esES text, other Spanish regions use the Latin American esMX text; Portuguese uses the game's ptBR text). In English, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese, items, skills and monsters use the original Diablo II wording, and everything we added — Greater Rift, Chronicle, the settings page, gesture prompts, map name plates — is translated too (item notes are translated for Chinese and Spanish only). Russian is the game's single ruRU text, Korean its koKR text and Portuguese its ptBR (Brazilian) text, with no regional variants. Voice acting: Chinese UI gets Chinese voices; Russian, Korean and Portuguese get the original voices when your game files include them (a package built from the complete game data does), otherwise English; everything else is English. Korean was contributed by [@soulsakura](https://github.com/soulsakura) ([#118](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/118)).

## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR G["Your game files
(program + resources)"] --> P["Rewriter
changes only a few instructions"] G --> S["Shader translation
original → Metal"] P --> H["Host
system services"] S --> X["Graphics layer
the graphics API on Metal"] H --> A["iOS app
touch and interface"] X --> A ``` | Part | Where | What it does | |---|---|---| | Program rewriter | `dm/tools/patch_nso.py` | Rewrites only the few instructions that cannot run unchanged under Apple's kernel (thread-pointer registers, system calls, timers) and leaves the rest of the program byte-for-byte as shipped | | Host | `dm/host` | Loads the rewritten program and provides the platform services it calls | | Graphics | `dm/gfx` | Implements the game's graphics API on Metal; shaders are translated offline from the game's originals | | iOS app | `dm/ios` | The app shell, touch controls and interface | | Android app | `dm/android` | The Android shell, touch overlay and Vulkan presentation | | HarmonyOS app | `dm/harmony` | The HarmonyOS shell (ArkTS + N-API), sharing the host and the Vulkan engine with Android | | Vulkan graphics | `dm/gfx/vulkan` | The same graphics API on Vulkan (shared by Android and HarmonyOS; the engine comes from the HarmonyOS port) | | Verification | `dm/verify` | Checks that the rewritten code behaves exactly like the original, plus the regression gates every change goes through | **Why you can trust it:** the stability is not luck. The test and verification tooling is part of the project — unit tests for the host and graphics layers, an equivalence check for every rewritten instruction, scripted walkthrough regression for the touch interface, and on-device smoke tests. Start with `make -C dm/host/tests run`, `make -C dm/gfx/tests run` and `dm/verify/regress.sh` (run them inside the Python environment prepared in step 2 below; `regress.sh` also needs `brew install llvm`). How to contribute is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Android (new in v2.0) Android phones use ARM64 processors just like the Switch, so, as on Apple devices, the game's own program executes directly on the phone with no CPU emulation. This release brings the whole host — system calls, file system, audio, input, saves — to Android unchanged and swaps the graphics layer for Vulkan: the NVN-to-Vulkan replay engine comes from [@biglawine](https://github.com/biglawine)'s HarmonyOS port, and the Android app, touch controls, Vulkan presentation and a full round of performance work, each step measured on a phone, are by [@yyan160](https://github.com/yyan160) ([#113](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/113)). The Apple and Android versions share the same host code, so future changes benefit both. Measured by the port's authors on their phones (product defaults: 3D render scale capped at 0.85 and lowered dynamically when frames drop): | Phone | Result | |---|---| | Redmi K50 Ultra (Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, Adreno 730, Android 15) | Camp, Den of Evil fight, Cow Level fight: **median 60 fps**, GPU about 14–15 ms a frame | | OnePlus 13 (Adreno 830) | Playable; when one particular light effect appears in the camp, small black squares occasionally flash for an instant (under investigation) | Minimum: ARM64, Android 12 (API 31) or later, and a GPU with Vulkan 1.1. **How to use it today**: install `D2RMobile-android.apk` from the release page (it contains no game content). On a computer, run `python3 dm/tools/d2rm_android.py ` on your own game files to make the import pack (an `android` folder with the rewritten game program, every Vulkan shader bundle, the touch overlay and a few data tables), and copy it together with your game resources (the `data` folder) to `Download/S2X/D2R Mobile/` on the phone. The App imports it with a progress screen when you open it. No adb, and no need to build the APK yourself. The full steps are in [docs/ANDROID.md](docs/ANDROID.md). The touch controls are drawn the same way as on iPhone (button sockets, silver skill silhouettes, joystick), and no virtual pad buttons cover open panels. Compared with the iOS version, a few touch details are still unfinished: the empty-skill-slot menu, the stat-point overlay, and the item image that follows your finger while dragging in a shop. Progress, the measurements from every round and the remaining work are in [docs/ANDROID_COLLABORATION.md](docs/ANDROID_COLLABORATION.md) and [docs/android-notes/](docs/android-notes/). The HarmonyOS version is in the next section. ## HarmonyOS (new in v2.0) The HarmonyOS NEXT app (`dm/harmony`) is by [@biglawine](https://github.com/biglawine) ([#114](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/114)) and uses the same host and the same Vulkan engine as Android. Measured by the author on a Mate 90 Pro Max (Maleoon 955): 59.7 fps holding the joystick in the Rogue Encampment, display interval p50 16.6 / p99 18.1 ms. **How to use it**: the same idea as the iOS shell. The Releases page has an **unsigned install package that contains no game content** (`D2RMobile-harmony-shell-unsigned.hap`). HarmonyOS NEXT only installs apps signed with your own developer certificate, so you re-sign it with your own debug certificate and install it; you do not build the app yourself. Then, on a computer, run `python3 dm/tools/d2rm_android.py --target ohos ` on your own game files to make the runtime pack, put it with the game resources in a "D2R Mobile" folder on the phone, open the app and pick that folder to import. The full steps are in [docs/HARMONYOS.md](docs/HARMONYOS.md). The author ran the whole chain (re-sign → install → first import → into a game → save and exit) on a Mate 90 Pro Max, with three cold starts in a row working; you need a Huawei developer account (DevEco Studio can generate the debug certificate and register the device for you). ## Which devices are supported Minimum: **an A14 / M1 chip or later** — the graphics layer needs Metal 3, which Apple supports from A14 / M1 on (see Apple's [Metal support on Apple devices](https://support.apple.com/102894) and [Metal Feature Set Tables](https://developer.apple.com/metal/Metal-Feature-Set-Tables.pdf)). | Device | Playable? | How | How sure we are | |---|---|---|---| | **iPhone / iPad, A17 Pro and later** (iPhone 15 Pro and later, iPhone 16 and later, iPads with M-series chips) | Yes | iOS 26 or later: the default shell / default build; iOS 18 – 25: the iOS 18 shell / [older-API build](docs/OLDER_SYSTEMS.md) | Main devices, played daily | | **iPhone Duo** (foldable) | Yes; the picture resizes when you unfold or fold | The shells on the Releases page are built with Xcode 27.1; when building with Xcode yourself, use 27.1 so the inner screen is filled (see [docs/DEPENDENCIES.md](docs/DEPENDENCIES.md)) | Supported since v2.0. Checked on a Mac switching between the outer and inner screen sizes taken from the iPhone Duo simulator (the simulator itself cannot run the game's graphics). The full list of dependencies is in [docs/DEPENDENCIES.md](docs/DEPENDENCIES.md). ### With a Mac: three steps 1. Put your game files in the workspace (default `~/dm-work`, or set `DM_ROOT`): ``` ~/dm-work/data/switch/3.3.94012/Update/ExeFS/ main, sdk, subsdk0 ~/dm-work/data/switch/3.3.94012/Update/RomFS/ data/… ``` 2. Prepare the workspace. This checks your tools, rewrites the game program, and translates the game's shaders to Metal. The first run takes a while; later runs skip what is already done. ``` ./setup.sh source ~/dm-work/build/cache/dm/venv/bin/activate # run everything after this inside the Python environment setup prepared; if you changed DM_ROOT, use it in place of ~/dm-work ``` 3. Fill in your signing details and build the app: ``` cp dm/ios/local.env.example dm/ios/local.env # set DM_TEAM_ID and DM_BUNDLE_ID; with a free Apple ID also set DM_FREE_ACCOUNT=1 and DM_IOS_UDID, and keep the phone connected while building cd dm/ios && ./run.sh build # targets both iPhone and iPad by default; for iPhone only: DM_DEVICE_FAMILY=1 ./run.sh build ``` The first time you open the app on your phone, it asks for the "game resource folder" — the 18 resource archives from your game files. Where to put them is in the section "The "game resource folder" that goes on the phone" of [docs/GAME_FILES.md](docs/GAME_FILES.md). `./setup.sh check` is a health check: it reports the state of this computer, the tools, the game files and the signing configuration item by item, and for everything missing it says where to get it and which command to run next; it changes nothing. If what you have is a whole game package (`.xci` / `.nsp`), `./setup.sh ` first extracts the game files into place and then carries on (install hactool first); if the base game and the update are separate packages, give both: `./setup.sh `. Run `./setup.sh` again after every update to a new commit: it rebuilds the patched binaries and the shader library for the current sources (steps that are already up to date are skipped). It also rewrites three files in the repository that change with your local tool fingerprints (`dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_chain.lock`, `dm/gfx/nvn/dmsh_chain.h`, `dm/gfx/nvn/c1_full.tsv`); that is expected, do not commit them. ### Playing directly on a Mac After the same `./setup.sh`, one more command builds a native macOS App that starts on double-click and works with keyboard, mouse and gamepad, with no developer account: ```bash source ~/dm-work/build/cache/dm/venv/bin/activate dm/tools/mac_app.sh # macOS 26 or later: produces ~/dm-work/out/macapp/D2R Mobile.app DM_MAC_M3=1 dm/tools/mac_app.sh # macOS 15 – 25: produces D2R Mobile M3.app ``` The interface is the original's gamepad interface. Keyboard: Space confirms, Esc goes back, Return, the `=` key opens the menu / a new character, W A S D moves, and every other gamepad button has a key. Mouse: clicking a monster, NPC or object walks over and interacts, and the skill slots, potion cells and key hints at the bottom, buttons and tabs in panels, the class figures when creating a character and the minimap can all be clicked; clicking empty ground walks there and holding keeps walking, clicking a monster attacks it, and items take double clicks and drags. With a keyboard, the prompts on screen show keyboard keys. Saves stay on this Mac (iCloud sync needs a paid developer account and a build with `DM_MAC_ICLOUD=1`, see [docs/MAC.md](docs/MAC.md)) and can be imported by hand from an iPhone / iPad. The key table, how to create a character, what the mouse can do, the import steps and the known shortcomings are in [docs/MAC.md](docs/MAC.md). Keyboard and a physical gamepad have not been operated by a person yet — if you try it, please tell us how it went. ### Android No Mac, no adb and no building the APK yourself; any Windows / Linux / Mac computer will do (it has been run through on a Mac so far). The full steps, the tools to install and what to do when something goes wrong are in [docs/ANDROID.md](docs/ANDROID.md). 1. Prepare your game files, the same as for Apple devices ([docs/GAME_FILES.md](docs/GAME_FILES.md)). 2. Make the import pack on a computer: ``` python3 dm/tools/d2rm_android.py ``` 3. Download `D2RMobile-android.apk` from the [Releases page](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/releases), install it, open it and allow "All files access"; the App imports the pack and starts the game. The source must be from the same release as the APK; for a new release, replace both the APK and the import pack, and your saves stay. You need a Huawei developer account and DevEco Studio (for its signing tool and `hdc`; it can also generate the debug certificate and register the phone). Prepare your game files, the same as for Apple devices ([docs/GAME_FILES.md](docs/GAME_FILES.md)). 2. Download the unsigned shell `D2RMobile-harmony-shell-unsigned.hap` from the [Releases page](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/releases), re-sign it with your own debug certificate and profile (`hap-sign-tool sign-app`), then install it on the phone with `hdc install -r`. 3. Make the runtime pack on a computer: ``` python3 dm/tools/d2rm_android.py --target ohos ``` 4. On the phone, make a "D2R Mobile" folder with the game resources in `data/` and the runtime pack from the previous step in `dm/`, open the app, tap Import and pick that folder. The source must be from the same release as the shell. For a new release, re-sign the new shell with the same signing and install it over the old one; your saves are kept. The shell is build input, not an app to install (installed as is, it only shows a dialog and does not start the game); when you move to a new release, make the install package again with the new shell. On this route only, because the computer making the package has no Apple shader compiler, the **first launch** on the phone spends about 7 minutes compiling shaders (once, with a progress bar); a package built with Xcode has no such step. The steps, and how far each one has been verified, are in [docs/NO_XCODE.md](docs/NO_XCODE.md). ## Known limitations | Item | Status | |---|---| | Online play | Out of scope; fully offline | | Android version | A few iOS touch details (empty-skill-slot menu, stat-point overlay, the item image that follows your finger in a shop) are unfinished; see "Android" above | | `.nsp` / `.xci` game packages | The tools only check the version of the main program and do not distinguish package formats; we ran the whole path with an `.xci` ourselves, and users have reported that `.nsp` packages work perfectly as well | | Signing and installing with a sideloading tool (Sideloadly, AltStore and the like) | Not verified; open an issue and tell us how it went | | Making the package on Linux | Not verified (verified on Windows and Mac) | | Devices that have not moved to iOS 26 / macOS 26 | Playable with the older-API build (minimum iOS 18.0 / macOS 15.0): [docs/OLDER_SYSTEMS.md](docs/OLDER_SYSTEMS.md); the full device table is under "Which devices are supported" above | | A16 and earlier devices (iPhone 14 family, iPhone 15 / 15 Plus and so on) | Playable; they need a Legacy Device Pack and an App built with it: [docs/LEGACY_DEVICES.md](docs/LEGACY_DEVICES.md). "One More Step for This Device" (older versions say "Device Not Supported") in the App means this step is missing | | The "one-line verdict" and "legacy Chinese name" entries in item notes | These two content tables are not shipped with the repository; you can supply your own, see `dm/ios/tools/annot/README.md` | ## Contributing and feedback - If you hit a problem, open an issue (there is a template); attaching the file exported by Share Diagnostics in the pause menu helps the most. - For the items marked not verified, tell us whether they worked or not. Either answer is valuable. - To change the code: get the test entry points above passing first. Apple silicon Macs already have a native version (see "Playing directly on a Mac" above), built from the same game program and the same host; Apple TV also has a community port (developer preview, see the device table). Android has been reached too: since v2.0 there is a community-ported Android version (see "Android" above) built on the same host, with only the graphics layer swapped for Vulkan; a HarmonyOS version has arrived too (see "HarmonyOS" above), sharing the same Vulkan engine. **Taking it to other games:** someone has already tried other Switch games on the same host. The host has some behaviour that is on by default on iOS and was written for this one game; another game runs into these first, so turn them off or move them out before you start: - `dm/host/hle_oe.c`: the 3D render scale defaults to 0.75 on phones (the Android app sets 0.85), and `scale3d_tick` rewrites it at offsets inside this game's renderer — with another game that is a wild pointer. - `dm/host/hle_fs.c`: seeding the shared stash on first launch (`DM_STASH_SEED`) and the touch-layout default settings (`DM_TOUCH_DEFAULTS`) are on by default on iOS. - `dm/host/main.c`: the save-flush throttle patches a constant at a fixed address in the game program; `argv[0]` is hard-coded to `"D2R"`. - `dm/host/hle_time.c`: the fixed-time test switch recognises a fixed address in the game program. - `front_game_res` in `dm/host/front_mac.m`: the docked / handheld resolutions are hard-coded to 1600×900 / 1280×720. - `dm/host/dm_cloudsync.c`: character directories are recognised by `.d2s`. - `dm/host/dm_cursor.c` and `dm/host/dm_world.c`: the whole files are specific to this game. # D2R Mobile **开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临兼容层，支持 iOS、macOS、安卓与鸿蒙。** 把你自己购买的 Nintendo Switch 版游戏（含「术士君临」资料片）完整带到 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上：原版内核原生执行，整套操作为触屏重做，稳定 60 帧，一秒进局。现在也有原生的 macOS 版（第一版）：Apple 芯片的 Mac 上双击启动，键盘、鼠标、手柄都能用。**v2.0 起有了安卓版**（社区移植）：同一份游戏程序在 ARM64 安卓手机上原生执行，图形在 Vulkan 上重新实现；骁龙 8+ 一代的手机上，营地、邪恶洞穴和奶牛关的战斗都是中位 60 帧，详见下面的「安卓版」；同一套引擎上还有鸿蒙版（社区移植，发布页下载未签名壳、自己重签即可，不用自己构建，见「鸿蒙版」）。Apple TV 4K（第三代 A15）有社区移植（开发者预览），只在作者的实机上到过职业选择画面，详见下面的设备表。 这不是一个「勉强能跑」的技术演示，而是一个打磨到可以天天玩、从开荒一路玩到终局的移动版。 平台：iPhone / iPad（iOS 26 起；iOS 18 – 25 用旧接口版）· Mac（Apple 芯片，macOS 26 及以上；macOS 15 – 25 用旧接口版）· Apple TV 4K（第三代 A15，社区移植，开发者预览）· 安卓手机（ARM64，Android 12 起，Vulkan 1.1；社区移植）· 鸿蒙手机（HarmonyOS NEXT；社区移植，发布页的未签名壳 + 自己重签）· 游戏版本：Switch 版「术士君临」1.0.34.0（对应 PC 版 3.3.94012）· 中文 / English / Español / Русский / 한국어 · 许可证：MIT · **需要自备游戏文件** English: [README.md](README.md) · Español: [README.es.md](README.es.md)

| 100% | 60 帧 | 约 1 秒 | 约 3.8 W | |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | 原版玩法，跑的就是原版程序 | 稳定，热机不掉帧 | 从主菜单进到局里 | 60 帧时的整机功耗 | ## 这是什么，不是什么 **是：** - 游戏自己的 aarch64 程序**直接在设备上执行**，没有模拟 CPU。iPhone 和 Switch 是同一类处理器，程序里只有极少数在苹果内核下不能原样执行的指令被改写，其余逐字节保持原样。所有职业、全部符文之语、恐怖地带、首领、掉落规则、任务流程，都和原版一模一样。 - 游戏需要的平台服务——系统调用、文件系统、图形接口、音频、输入——由一个为苹果平台写的小型宿主提供；图形接口完全重新实现——苹果上用 Metal，安卓上用 Vulkan——中间不经过任何模拟层，着色器由游戏原版离线翻译。 - 一次真正为手机做的移植，而且做到了底：整套触屏操作、全面屏与 iPad 真全屏、手柄支持、省电模式、存档同步、中英西俄韩葡六种语言，以及一整套原版没有的终局玩法与便利功能。 **不是：** - 不是模拟器，也不是云游戏或串流。 - **不含、也不分发任何游戏内容。** 仓库里没有游戏程序、美术、文字、数据表或着色器，这些都在你自己的机器上、用你自己的文件现做出来（见 [docs/GAME_FILES.zh-CN.md](docs/GAME_FILES.zh-CN.md)）。仓库里带着的是我们为适配而记录的接口信息——着色器的接口描述、图形接口的函数表、程序内的地址等——逐项列在 [docs/DERIVED.zh-CN.md](docs/DERIVED.zh-CN.md)。 - 不支持联机，游戏完全离线运行，不需要任何联网账号。 ## 经过实战检验 内测的 **44 台** iPhone 与 iPad——35 台登记设备（25 台 iPhone、10 台 iPad），加上 9 个 TestFlight 账号各一台——**全部顺利完成了普通、噩梦、地狱三个难度的多角色通关**，体验极佳。从 6 GB 内存的 iPhone 14 Pro Max 到最新的 iPad Pro，没有一台掉队。 | | 机型 | |---|---| | iPhone | 14 Pro Max、15、15 Pro、15 Pro Max、16 Plus、16 Pro、16 Pro Max、17 Pro Max 等 | | iPad | iPad Air、iPad mini、iPad Pro 11 寸与 12.9 / 13 寸（含 M2、M4）等 | | 最低实测机型 | **iPhone 14 Pro Max（A16，6 GB 内存）：60 帧完美运行** | iPhone 与 iPad 共用一个安装包。

## 极速、流畅、省电 真机实测（iPhone 17 Pro Max）： | 项 | 读数 | |---|---| | 局内帧率 | **60 帧**，稳定，热机不掉帧 | | App 启动 | 0.15 秒 | | 到主菜单 | 约 1 秒 | | 从主菜单进到局里 | **约 1 秒** | | 一键重开，回到局里 | 约 1.2 秒 | | 换幕时最长的一帧 | 约 0.1 秒 | | 整机功耗，60 帧 | **约 3.8 W**（营地，亮度 50%），满电可连续玩近 5 小时 | | 整机功耗，省电模式 30 帧 | **约 1.85 W**，约为 60 帧时的一半，续航约翻倍 | 测量条件：功耗为 2026-10-10 在 iPhone 17 Pro Max 上量的整机功耗，第一幕营地站立，亮度 50%，60 帧与省电模式同场景；续航由实测功耗与电池容量换算，不是从满电玩到没电。启动与入局时间为 2026-10 同机型实测；帧率与换幕为 2026-10-12 同机型进局后走图、换幕的读数。 安装包只有一百多 MB；游戏资源（约 5.6 GB）单独放进手机，升级 App 时存档和资源都不动。 之所以能这么快：程序是原生执行的，没有一条指令经过模拟；图形直接走 Metal；着色器全部离线翻译、预先编好，进新场景不用现编。旧机型（A16 及更早，如 iPhone 14 系列、iPhone 15）不支持游戏原本的贴图压缩格式，要用你自己的游戏文件另做一份贴图包，同样满帧——做法见 [docs/LEGACY_DEVICES.zh-CN.md](docs/LEGACY_DEVICES.zh-CN.md)。 ## 为手指重新设计 这不是把手柄按键贴到屏幕上。每一个面板、每一种操作都按手指重新做过，设计原则只有一条：**沿用原版的界面语言，靠手势而不是往屏幕上加按钮**；字号和点击范围按手指大小重新设计。上手就会，玩久了也顺。

- **走**：摇杆移动，斜推方向精准；点 NPC、点地面自动寻路；门、传送门、洞口整扇都能点中。 - **打**：技能按钮按下就放、按住连放、**拖动朝任意角度瞄准**，附近有怪自动锁定。两组技能；副手技能一键放——自动换武器、放技能、换回来，按钮上显示剩余次数。 - **首领血条**固定在屏幕顶部，显示剩余百分比。 - **物品**：单击、双击、长按、拖放全部跟手。双击装备直接穿上或卸下，拖到商人面板任意位置就能卖；成叠物品双击取 1 个、长按取 3 个；长按背包空格一键整理。 - **文字**：用系统键盘输入，角色名可以用中文，留空随机取名。 - **屏幕**：iPhone 19.5:9 全面屏铺满，避开刘海和圆角；iPad 游戏画面铺满整块屏幕，打开功能页时界面自动居中；3D 画面可加亮。 ### 手柄 接上手柄、按任意键，界面自动换成原版手柄布局，每个面板底部带按键提示；碰一下屏幕，立刻回到触屏界面。物品栏、储藏箱、技能树、编年史、设置页全程手柄可操作，键位与 Switch 一致。接的是 Xbox 手柄时会自动换成 PC / Xbox 版的键位（下确认、右返回），按键提示也换成 Xbox 的图标，不用去设置里开。接的是 PlayStation 手柄（DualSense 或 DualShock 4）时，按键提示自动换成游戏原版的 PS 图标（✕ 确认、○ 返回），由 [@Ti800](https://github.com/Ti800) 贡献（[#119](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/119)）。

## 原版之上的新玩法 原版通关只是开始。我们在不动原版规则的前提下，加了一整套让人刷得停不下来的终局内容。 ### 秘境 通关地狱后从哈洛加斯的红门进入。共 100 层，怪物逐层变强；15 分钟内攒满进度、打倒守护者即过关。每过 2 层 +1 技能点、+5 属性点，技能等级上限从 20 提到 40；每 10 层有首通奖励；打通 10 层解锁佣兵的六个新装备位。

### 终局首领连战、极乐世界、刷怪积分牌 - **终局首领连战**：地狱难度通关后开启，共 12 关；第 11 关是暗黑克隆，第 12 关是超级三首领。 - **极乐世界模式**（建角时勾选）：暗金 ×5、套装 ×3、符文 ×5，「不掉落」的概率缩小十倍，首领每次都按首杀掉落。 - **刷怪积分牌**：每个首领的击杀次数、首杀时间、出了多少暗金与套装、最快和平均用时。

### 仓库：装备党的收纳天堂 - **编年史仓库**：每件已鉴定的暗金、套装各有固定一格，所有角色共用，可搜索、存取；「存放」按钮一键把背包和魔盒里的暗金、套装收进去。 - **储藏箱**加宽到 14 列，个人仓库 5 页，共享仓库 5 页。 - **珍宝匣**：宝石、符文、材料三页合成一页，中间就是魔盒的合成格，找东西、做合成不用来回翻页。往个人页或共享页里存的符文、宝石、材料会自动归进来。 - **百宝囊**：扩展背包。野外的符文、宝石自动收进来，不占背包格。

### 省心刷宝 | | | |---|---| | 增益技能自动补 | 学了的增益技能不用摆在技能栏上：身上的增益没了，站定的那一刻自动补放；副手武器带的增益（如战争召唤）自动换手、补上、再换回 | | 药水与腰带 | 自动喝药分两档：生命低于 50% 喝红药，低于 30% 喝紫药；**佣兵同样自动喂药**。腰带有空位自动捡起地上的药水；双击腰带空格一键补满 | | 掉落过滤 | 进噩梦起自动启用原版的战利品过滤器，把杂物藏起来：噩梦轻筛，地狱重筛 | | 自动拾取 | 低号符文和宝石自动收进百宝囊，高号的留给你亲手捡 | | 高价值掉落提醒 | 高级符文和暗金冒光柱、换一个落地音，手机按价值震动轻、中、重三档 | | 符文之语助手 | 长按带孔底材，列出能做的符文之语和属性；符文齐了一键镶嵌 | | 小地图指引 | 每张地图标出小站和出入口，并写上传送点和入口通向的区域名（iOS / Mac）；所有任务终点上图；目标在画面外时贴着屏幕边写名字 | | 省掉的琐事 | 鉴定免费、回城免费、进局直接落在传送小站旁、一键重开、商人货架可刷新、找阿卡拉洗点免费且不限次数 | | 存档 | 切后台、划掉、退出都立刻存盘；iCloud 多设备同步（需要付费开发者账号签名） | | 娱乐模式（实验） | 越肩视角与第一人称：右半屏拖动看四周、画面外怪物指针、地图上的人物朝向指针（[说明](docs/over-the-shoulder-camera.zh-CN.md)；与 [@yyan160](https://github.com/yyan160) 合作，[#165](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/165)） | 多数功能能在游戏里「选项 → 自定义」页逐项开关。

### 中文、英文、西班牙语、俄语、韩语与葡萄牙语 整个游戏可在「选项 → 自定义」里切换中文、英文、西班牙语、俄语、韩语或葡萄牙语（六项、两行三列），重启后界面就是所选语言；第一次打开时跟随设备语言（西班牙的西语用原版 esES 文字，其他地区的西语用拉美 esMX 文字；葡语用原版 ptBR 文字）。英文、西语、俄语、韩语和葡语下，物品、技能、怪物名沿用原版译名，我们新增的内容——秘境、编年史、设置页、手势提示、地图名牌——也全部配了对应语言（物品注释只有中文与西语）。语音：中文界面配中文语音；俄语、韩语、葡语界面在你的游戏文件里带对应配音时（用完整游戏数据出的包都带）配原版俄语、韩语、葡语语音，否则配英文；其余配英文语音。韩语由 [@soulsakura](https://github.com/soulsakura) 贡献（[#118](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/118)）。

## 怎么做到的 ```mermaid flowchart LR G["你的游戏文件
（程序 + 资源）"] --> P["改写器
只改少数指令"] G --> S["着色器翻译
原版 → Metal"] P --> H["宿主
系统服务"] S --> X["图形层
Metal 上的图形接口"] H --> A["iOS App
触屏与界面"] X --> A ``` | 部分 | 位置 | 做什么 | |---|---|---| | 程序改写器 | `dm/tools/patch_nso.py` | 只改写在苹果内核下不能原样执行的少数指令（线程指针寄存器、系统调用、计时器），程序其余部分逐字节保持原样 | | 宿主 | `dm/host` | 装载改写后的程序，提供它调用的平台服务 | | 图形 | `dm/gfx` | 在 Metal 上实现游戏用的图形接口；着色器由游戏原版离线翻译 | | iOS App | `dm/ios` | App 外壳、触摸操作与界面 | | 安卓 App | `dm/android` | 安卓外壳、触屏覆盖层、Vulkan 呈现 | | 鸿蒙 App | `dm/harmony` | 鸿蒙外壳（ArkTS + N-API），与安卓共用宿主和 Vulkan 引擎 | | Vulkan 图形层 | `dm/gfx/vulkan` | 在 Vulkan 上实现同一套图形接口（安卓、鸿蒙共用；引擎来自鸿蒙移植） | | 验证 | `dm/verify` | 核对改写后的代码与原版行为完全一致，以及每次改动都要过的回归闸门 | **为什么可信：** 稳定不是靠运气。测试与验证工具是项目的一部分——宿主与图形层的单元测试、对每一处改写指令的等价核对、触摸界面的脚本化走查回归、真机冒烟。从 `make -C dm/host/tests run`、`make -C dm/gfx/tests run` 与 `dm/verify/regress.sh` 开始（都在下面第 2 步准备的 Python 环境里跑；`regress.sh` 另需 `brew install llvm`）。怎么参与见 [CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)。 ## 安卓版（v2.0 新增） 安卓手机和 Switch 一样是 ARM64 处理器，所以和苹果上一样，游戏自己的程序直接在手机上执行，没有模拟 CPU。这一版把整套宿主——系统调用、文件系统、音频、输入、存档——原样带到了安卓上，图形层换成 Vulkan：NVN→Vulkan 的回放引擎来自 [@biglawine](https://github.com/biglawine) 的鸿蒙移植，安卓 App、触屏、Vulkan 呈现和一整轮在真机上逐项测量的性能优化由 [@yyan160](https://github.com/yyan160) 完成（[#113](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/113)）。苹果版和安卓版用的是同一份宿主代码，以后的改动两边一起受益。 合作者的真机实测（产品缺省设置：3D 渲染比例上限 0.85，按掉帧动态调低）： | 手机 | 读数 | |---|---| | Redmi K50 Ultra（骁龙 8+ 一代，Adreno 730，Android 15） | 营地、邪恶洞穴战斗、奶牛关战斗：**中位 60 帧**，GPU 每帧约 14–15 ms | | OnePlus 13（Adreno 830） | 能玩；营地里有一种光效出现时，偶尔会闪过一瞬的小黑块，正在查 | 最低要求：ARM64，Android 12（API 31）及以上，显卡支持 Vulkan 1.1。 **现在怎么用**：装发布页的 `D2RMobile-android.apk`（不含任何游戏内容），在电脑上用你自己的游戏文件跑 `python3 dm/tools/d2rm_android.py <输出目录>` 做出导入包（`android` 文件夹：改写后的游戏程序、全部 Vulkan 着色器包、触屏覆盖层与几张数据表），把它和游戏资源（`data` 文件夹）一起拷到手机的 `Download/S2X/D2R Mobile/`，打开 App 会带进度条自己导入。不用 adb，也不用自己编 APK。完整步骤见 [docs/ANDROID.zh-CN.md](docs/ANDROID.zh-CN.md)。触屏控件和 iPhone 版同一套画法（按钮底座、银灰技能剪影、摇杆），面板打开时不再压着虚拟手柄圆钮。和 iOS 版相比，还没做完的是几处触屏细节：空技能格菜单、加点浮层、商店拖动时跟着手指的物品图。 开发进度、每一轮的实测记录与待办在 [docs/ANDROID_COLLABORATION.zh-CN.md](docs/ANDROID_COLLABORATION.zh-CN.md) 和 [docs/android-notes/](docs/android-notes/)。鸿蒙版见下一节。 ## 鸿蒙版（v2.0 新增） 鸿蒙 NEXT 应用（`dm/harmony`）由 [@biglawine](https://github.com/biglawine) 完成（[#114](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/pull/114)），和安卓用同一份宿主和同一套 Vulkan 引擎。作者在 Mate 90 Pro Max（马良 955）上实测：罗格营地按住摇杆 59.7 帧，上屏间隔 p50 16.6 / p99 `dm/host/hle_time.c`：固定时刻的测试开关认的是游戏程序里的一个固定地址。 - `dm/host/front_mac.m` 的 `front_game_res`：底座 / 掌机两档分辨率写死成 1600×900 / 1280×720。 - `dm/host/dm_cloudsync.c`：按 `.d2s` 认角色目录。 - `dm/host/dm_cursor.c`、`dm/host/dm_world.c`：整个文件都是这个游戏专属的。 更干净的做法是把这些缺省值挪进各游戏自己的配置，宿主里不带游戏专属的缺省；欢迎朝这个方向提合并请求。 ## 各部分的说明 | 说明 | 讲什么 | |---|---| | [dm/README.zh-CN.md](dm/README.zh-CN.md) |
